a: A read-only number field shows its value rounded to `step`, where the editable field shows every decimal
A read-only boolean with no value reads "—", where the field's own contract and control read it as off
Holding Space or Enter on a row's auto toggle flips the row between pinned and auto on every key repeat
A boolean `toggle` field in a row whose label is not a string draws an empty segment
b: A read-only typed number field rounds its value to whole numbers, while the editable field shows full precision
A read-only boolean with no value reads "—", while the field type and the editable control treat it as off
A validation message that wraps marks an inline row multiline, which changes how its label and control align
`readout={false}` or `hint={false}` draws an empty readout or hint box, and shifts an inline slider row's layout
